title: Validate that both OARGT liquidation widgets explicitly report an empty list
notes: The reader searched the whole page for both empty notices and required only the own widget ID. A missing widget or a notice from a different section could be accepted as a confirmed empty list.
done_when: Only unambiguous empty notices scoped to both present widgets establish that both lists are empty. Offline tests reject missing, inactive and contradictory markup. Populated rows still need their documented response contract.
result: Validate that both OARGT liquidation widgets explicitly report an empty list
evidence: The built reader still verifies both empty lists in every one of four archived replay responses.
